summary: Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (auth, dashboard, POs, invoices, costs, employees RBAC). Frontend (390x844): role-based tabs verified for Owner (4 tabs), PM (po+operational only), Engineer (operational only); logout works; Add PO modal now saves and new PO appears in list; invoice status toggle persists (Terbayar<->Belum); Submit Ops empty-remarks validation shown; cost submission with remarks succeeds. Two minor console issues: duplicate React key warning when multiple POs share a project name (Select options), and deprecated pointerEvents prop in Toast. Deprecated packages: none detected.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated in RN; move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:152 (Toast <View pointerEvents=\"none\">)

Duplicate React key warning 'Moratel DWDM' — projectNames list can contain duplicate project names across POs, then Select maps options with key={opt}. Dedupe project names before passing to Select. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:407 (const projectNames = pos.map(...)) and Select options render at line 127.

action_items: Dedupe project names before passing to AddPOModal Select: Array.from(new Set(pos.map(p => p.project_name))). Fixes duplicate-key React warning.
Replace <View pointerEvents="none"> with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} in Toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager.
index.tsx is ~1200 lines; consider splitting Dashboard/POInvoice/SubmitOps/Employee into separate files under /app/frontend/app/components/ for maintainability.
PATCH /api/employees allows Owner to change role but there is no validation that role stays within ROLES set beyond Pydantic default — consider validating explicitly to prevent bad data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (role tabs, logout, dashboard, PO create, invoice toggle, ops validation + submit)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed cost/PO/employee entries via API; not cleaned up (idempotent-safe since unique IDs).
